gumroad_listing.description:
56,001 active licensed HVAC contractors and AC technicians in Texas — sourced from the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR) public database.

**License types included:**
- A/C Contractors
- A/C Technicians
- Service Technicians

**Fields per record:**
- Name
- License type
- License number
- Business address
- City
- ZIP code
- Phone number
- Expiration date
- TDLR source URL (every row verifiable)

**Key stats:**
- 56,001 active licensed HVAC professionals
- Updated May 2026
- One CSV file, instant download

**Important notes:**
- Data is sourced from the Texas TDLR (Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation) public license database — the official state regulatory database
- All records are active licensed professionals — business/regulatory contact information
- No personal email, no home addresses — this is a clean B2B licensing dataset
- Buyer is responsible for complying with applicable contact laws (CAN-SPAM, TCPA, Texas Business & Commerce Code)
- Must not use this data for consumer solicitation

**Who buys this:** Carrier/Trane/Lennox dealer territory reps, ServiceTitan & FieldEdge SDRs, refrigerant & parts suppliers, HVAC CE education companies, insurance brokers (liability/workers comp for HVAC).

**Data source:** Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR) via data.texas.gov — public government record, no auth bypass.
